vocabulary.definition: a state of matter similar to gas in which a certain portion of the particles are ionized
vocabulary.example: The sun is made up of plasma, which gives it its fiery appearance.

vocabulary.definition: relating to or resembling a crown or corona, especially the outer atmosphere of the sun or other celestial body
vocabulary.example: During a solar storm, the sun's corona becomes more visible.

vocabulary.definition: the action of forcing or throwing something out, especially a liquid or gas
vocabulary.example: Solar flares can cause massive ejections of particles into space.
A solar storm could wreak havoc on our technological infrastructure.

vocabulary.definition: to exaggerate or represent (something) as being greater, better, or more important than it actually is
vocabulary.example: It's hard to overstate the importance of preparing for potential disasters.

vocabulary.definition: a loss of electrical power in an area
vocabulary.example: Worldwide blackouts caused by a solar storm would have severe consequences.
